prompt: As of August 2024, who was president of the United States the last time The Beach Boys topped the chart on the Billboard Hot 100?
answer: Ronald Reagan. The Beach Boys’ most recent Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 was **“Kokomo,” which topped the chart in December 1988**, during Reagan’s presidency.
